acceptance_criteria.summary: Normal local dictation uses kosmos-local-stt; current managed model smoke used whisper_dll backend.
Main runtime never links native Whisper; native C API is dynamically loaded inside sidecar boundary.
Typed protocol supports status/load_model/preload/transcribe/cancel/unload/shutdown and serialization tests pass.
Recording start preloads local model and warm sidecar model is reused for transcription.
Idle unload is handled by request-time checks and an active sidecar watcher that runs every 10 seconds by default.
Crash/retry tests and crash smoke prove controlled failure, pending WAV retention, and fresh sidecar restart.
Cancel interrupts active native inference and host state returns without partial injection.
Status exposes accelerator/device/profile; current machine reports gpu and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070.
Fast/accurate profiles and CPU/GPU control are wired and tested.
Baseline vs sidecar perf evidence captured on same WAV/model with timings and backend.
Pending queue guarantees covered by host/local tests and e2e local mock flow.
Source docs updated and docs sync/check pass.
